predictions: P-A (BB census, falsifiable). The union rule will fire in AT MOST 2 blocks of the new run, and wherever it fires it will be the CPL+BB side (LRT_CPLBB_CPL >= 9.2), NOT the Band+BB side, with kT in the 6-25 keV band — i.e. the HIGH-kT 'shoulder that Band's beta absorbs but CPL cannot' class, not the L28 edge-constrained (<~5 keV) class. Archival prior: 1/8 blocks (blk2, 5.49-8.98 s, LRT_CPLBB_CPL = 10.96, kT = 11.17); max Band-side LRT anywhere = 4.80. FALSIFIED if LRT_BANDBB_BAND >= 9.2 in any block, or if a passing block returns kT < 5 keV, or if >= 3 blocks pass.

P-A2 (BB is localized to the pulse peak, falsifiable). If the union rule fires at all, it will fire in the block(s) overlapping T0+5.5 to T0+9.0 s — the burst's brightest interval (BB-block significance 51.3 sigma on n0, catalog PF64 at T0+6.46 s, Lu+2018 pulse peak tm = 7.32 s). FALSIFIED if the only passing block lies entirely outside [4.5, 10.5] s.

P-B (time-integrated shape, falsifiable numbers). Over our stamped window (-1.6, +20.5) s with n0+n1+b0, the AIC winner will be a single-peak curved family (Band or SBPL, not CPL, not a +BB model) and the Band parameters will be alpha = -0.88 +/- 0.10, Ep = 113 +/- 15 keV, beta = -2.5 +/- 0.3. Anchors: archival blk-1 (alpha -0.877, Ep 112.6, beta -2.519) and catalog flnc Band (alpha -1.033, Ep 117.1, beta -2.286 over the WIDER 45-s interval). FALSIFIED if Ep falls outside [98, 128] keV, or alpha outside [-0.98, -0.78], or if CPL beats Band by dAIC >= 10 window-integrated.

P-B2 (a real high-energy tail exists window-integrated, falsifiable). Band will beat CPL by dAIC >= 10 in the time-integrated fit (archival dAIC = 19.96; catalog PL is rejected at redchi2 1.86 vs Band 1.30). BUT in individual short blocks the Band-over-CPL preference will be weak or absent: at least 2 resolved blocks will have CPL within dAIC 2 of Band, or CPL winning outright. Physical reason recorded in advance: von Kienlin+2014 does not credit this burst with significant BGO emission, so beta is carried by the NaI 200-900 keV band and degrades fast when the exposure is cut up.

P-C (hard-to-soft, falsifiable). The per-block Band Ep sequence will decrease MONOTONICALLY from the first to the last block, spanning roughly 180 keV -> 45 keV, and a fit of log Ep vs log(t + t0) will give a slope in [-1.3, -0.5], consistent with Lu+2018's k_E = -0.83 +/- 0.15 and their class 'H'. FALSIFIED if any block's Ep exceeds the preceding block's by more than 1 sigma, or if the fitted slope falls outside that interval. NOTE the binning dependence: Lu+2018's finer bins show a local dip (72.9 keV at 6.49-7.29 s, then back to 91.3 keV) that our coarser blocks are expected to average away — a re-appearance of that dip in our blocks would be an interesting, NOT a falsifying, result.

P-D (two-break, falsifiable). No block will reach LRT_DSBPL_SBPL >= 9.2 and DSBPL will not win by dAIC >= 10 anywhere; bn111009282 will NOT enter the two-break census. Archival max = 3.76 (blk2), and DSBPL_VALID fails in half the blocks with xb railing to 589-890 keV. A DSBPL win would therefore be a genuine unpublished-decision finding and must first survive the L8 default-seed restart check.

P-E (temporal, falsifiable). T90(50-300 keV) will reproduce 20.7 +/- 4.2 s; a single FRED-like pulse peaking at T0+7.3 +/- 0.5 s with a decay-to-rise asymmetry near d/r ~ 8.7 (Lu+2018 r = 2.50, d = 21.68); a POSITIVE spectral lag of order 1 s between 100-300 keV and 25-50 keV (Lu+2018 tau-hat_31 = 0.95 +/- 0.14 s, sign convention: high energy leads). FALSIFIED by a negative or consistent-with-zero lag in that band pair, or by a symmetric or multi-peaked pulse.

P-F (frame trap, procedural — not falsifiable, binding). Before any number is called a discrepancy: (i) re-align the interval — catalog flnc is T0-1.024 -> +44.032 s (2.2x T90) vs our -1.6 -> +20.5 s, which alone explains an alpha shift of ~0.15 and an Ep shift of ~5-10 keV; (ii) re-align the detector set — catalog scat used n0,n1,n3,b0, we use n0,n1,b0 because n3 sits at 51.83 deg, outside the project's <=50 deg NaI rule; (iii) convert conventions — our CPL_XC is an e-folding energy (Ep = (2+index)*xc), catalog SBPL PARAM3 is a BREAK energy not a nuFnu peak; (iv) never average Shao+2017's tau (27.8 s, 1-keV extrapolation) with Lu+2018's tau-hat_31 (0.95 s, measured band pair).
